items.title: Could Blockchain Create Another Growth Lever for SoFi Technologies (SOFI) and Mastercard (MA)?
items.summary: On September 22, SoFi Technologies, Inc. (NASDAQ:SOFI) and Mastercard Incorporated (NYSE:MA) launched live stablecoin settlement across SoFi Bank’s debit and credit card program. Powered by SoFiUSD, the first stablecoin issued by a nationally chartered bank, SoFi is migrating its entire $25 billion card program to blockchain-based settlement on Mastercard’s global payment network.
